question: In a volleyball game, ‘libero’ is a ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**specialised defensive player**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The libero is a player specialized in defensive skills.
 
• They cannot attack the ball from above the net's height.
 
• The libero wears a different color jersey from the rest of the team.
 
• They cannot serve, block, or attempt to block.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Volleyball Positions**

 
 
• In volleyball, each player has a specific position and role.
 
• The main positions are setter, outside hitter, middle blocker, opposite hitter, and libero.
 
• The setter is the playmaker, setting up the ball for attackers.
 
• Outside hitters and opposite hitters are responsible for attacking and blocking.
 
• Middle blockers are key defensive players who block opponents' attacks.
 
 
 
• **Libero Rules**
 
 
• The libero is restricted to playing in the back row.
 
• A libero cannot attack the ball if it is above the height of the net.
 
• They are not allowed to serve (except in some specific competitions), block, or attempt to block.
 
• The libero position was introduced to enhance the defensive skills and ball control of the team.
 
 
 
• **Libero's Special Jersey**
 
 
• The libero must wear a jersey of a different color from their teammates to be easily distinguishable.
 
• This helps referees and players to identify the libero quickly, ensuring that libero rules are followed.
